discovery_notes: Follow-up to packet 257 (b074), reusing its keys; checked 256 (b075) and 225 (b096). 30 standard searches, snippets only. Released holds: NYCC Jack/Sally (EE per-pin copy), 4 Stitch costumes (retailer per-design lists; set identity hold). Cinderella 70th blind box 6 designs added. New Loungefly.com LEs: Pizza Planet, WALL-E, Meeko&Percy, Hercules, Goofy Movie, Child Eating Frog, Buzz&Alien Pop (WDPN1771), Child Buttons; set-only holds for Copper&Tod, Alice, AT-AT, Spider-Man, Christmas. New: ESB 40th + Deadpool blind boxes, Amazon DL65 and Mando LE. 4-pin packs, Robin Hood, Bug's Life, Marvel Comics still held.
